dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: It's the new play that Mr. Zubayr's working on.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Unsurprisingly, Miss Nilou will definitely be featured in it.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Plays at Zubayr Theater never disappoint. Every time a new production is out, researchers all rush over and grab tickets, no matter what research they have.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: You should definitely check them out.
